subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule technical deep-dive / loop in security & procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@finpath.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@finpath.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule technical deep-dive / loop in security & procurement

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand FinPath's priority use cases and constraints. Quick recap from our side: 
- Primary goal: deploy an LLM-powered customer support summarization pipeline with predictable latency (95p < 300ms for short prompts) and strong PII handling.
- Data constraints: sensitive financial PII, retention policy 90 days, will need KMS support and audit logs.
- Success metrics: 30% reduction in average resolution time, infra cost target <$0.002 per generated token.

Next steps: we recommend a technical deep-dive/demo with our SE and integration lead to cover architecture, data flow, security controls, and a short proof-of-concept plan. Can you confirm who on your side should join from security and procurement? I think a 60-minute slot should work. Proposed times (PT):
- Tue Mar 30, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Mar 31, 13:00–14:00
- Thu Apr 01, 10:00–11:00

If you can share which of those work, I’ll send a calendar invite + short agenda. I’m also looping in a couple folks on our side so they can attend: Rafael Mendes (SE) and Dev Patel (platform integrations) — they can speak to integration patterns and deployment options. Monica Patel (security engineering) will join the security portion.

Attaching a short overview and a starter mutual action plan for your review.

Attachments: [attachment: redwood-overview.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)], [attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
